{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of France|French cuisine]]

'''''Beurre à la Bourguignonne''''', or '''garlic butter''', is a compound butter flavored primarily with garlic. In this case, it also includes shallots and parsley.

==Ingredients==
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallots]]
*1–3 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], mashed or [[Cookbook:Grater|grated]] with a [[Cookbook:Microplane|microplane]]
*2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], chopped
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*[[cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] the butter until it is very soft.
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the shallots, garlic and parsley into the butter.
# Season to taste with salt and pepper.
